Dali

Full Erhai Lake loop day trip

A full 360° circuit of Erhai — Ideal Land, Little Putuo, Shuanglang, Xizhou and the S bend on the ecological corridor.

Request a Call

Itinerary

  • 09:00Depart from Dali old town.
  • Stop 1Xingsheng bridge, the photogenic arch bridge.
  • Stop 2Santorini–Ideal Land, built up the eastern shore hillside — whitewashed lanes with flowers on both sides, facing Erhai.
  • Stop 3Little Putuo, one of the eight causeway landmarks of Erhai — a tiny island with a pavilion, alone on the water.
  • Stop 4Shuanglang viewpoint. The town is known as the finest scenery spot on the lake.
  • Stop 5Xizhou ancient town — the oldest Tea Horse Road town in Dali, Bai residential architecture and local snacks.
  • Stop 6The northern section of the Erhai ecological corridor — a car-free shoreline path linking the Bai villages. The "S bend" viewpoint is the classic stop.
  • Stop 7Return to the old town. End of the 360-degree loop.
